Maya: Heads-up — ran a per-channel outlier scan after AWQ/GPTQ bakeoff on gpt-nexx-20b. Found concentrated channel-level spikes in a few attention/FFN layers, digging into mitigation experiments.
Maya: Quick command I used to generate the stats:
```
python tools/scan_outliers.py --model gpt-nexx-20b --quant awq --samples 5000 --threshold 6.0 --out s3://redwood-quant-artifacts/1769123456_outliers.json
```
Tomas: Nice. What were the accuracy impacts (ppl/LL) for naive AWQ vs per-channel rescale vs skip-layer?
Maya: Short summary (all eval on raw PTB-like dev promptset):
```
Baseline FP16    : ppl=12.30
AWQ naive int8  : ppl=14.80  (+2.50)
Per-channel rescale : ppl=13.00  (+0.70)
Skip layer 29 (kv matmul) : ppl=12.60  (+0.30)
Rescale + skip  : ppl=12.35  (+0.05)
```
Priya: Interesting — how about throughput / memory tradeoffs?
Maya: Measured on a T4-like dedicated instance:
- AWQ int8 raw: ~78 tok/s
- +per-channel-rescale: ~76 tok/s (tracking overhead negligible)
- +skip-layer 29: ~75 tok/s (~3% additional latency due to conditional branch)
- VRAM: about 1.6x reduction vs FP16 for AWQ int8; rescale metadata adds tiny overhead (<0.5% mem).
Luis: How were the "hot" channels selected? top variance? any bias correction step?
Maya: We computed per-channel stddev over 5k sampled sequences, flagged channels with stddev > 3x median. For rescale we use per-channel scale = max(abs(values))/127 * 1.1 (safety). Also clip to avoid extreme scaling on tiny channels.
Tomas: Can we make these actions pluggable in the quant pipeline? e.g. flags --adaptive-channel-rescale and --skip-layers-list so AWQ/GPTQ runs can toggle at build time.
quant-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-quant-artifacts/gpt-nexx/1769123456_outliers.json (checksum: sha256:abc123...)
Priya: If we add a variant for deployment, what do we call it? Any impact on model catalog/rollout naming?
Maya: Proposed variant: `gpt-nexx-awq-pcscale-skip29`. We'll create a model entry with metadata: quant=awq, mitigation=[pc-scale,skip-layer-29], rollout=canary->dedicated.
Luis: Suggest hooking regression checks into Redwood Optimize: any delta >0.2 ppl on the canonical promptset should auto-fail the rollout and trigger fallback to the previous variant.
Maya: I'll open a PR that adds the eval hook + unit tests for the promptset and the rescale code path. Also adding an integration test that runs AWQ+skip for a single batch to catch runtime errors.
Tomas: Nice. After PR we should run a small Dedicated canary and report latency/cost delta in the console dashboard (per-route breakdown).
Maya: Sounds good — I'll post the mini-bakeoff results + artifacts in the eng-ml channel when the PR is ready. :thumbsup:
